heading: Definitions
lead: In this subchapter, the following definitions apply:

tree.heading: Airport capacity enhancement project.—
tree.text: The term “airport capacity enhancement project” means—

children.text: a project for construction or extension of a runway, including any land acquisition, taxiway, or safety area associated with the runway or runway extension; or
such other airport development projects as the Secretary may designate as facilitating a reduction in air traffic congestion and delays.

tree.heading: Airport sponsor.—
tree.text: The term “airport sponsor” has the meaning given the term “sponsor” under section 47102.

tree.heading: Aviation safety project.—
tree.text: The term “aviation safety project” means an aviation project that—

children.text: has as its primary purpose reducing the risk of injury to persons or damage to aircraft and property, as determined by the Administrator;
is needed to respond to a recommendation from the National Transportation Safety Board, as determined by the Administrator; or
is necessary for an airport to comply with part 139 of title 14, Code of Federal Regulations (relating to airport certification).

tree.heading: Congested airport.—
tree.text: The term “congested airport” means an airport that accounted for at least 1 percent of all delayed aircraft operations in the United States in the most recent year for which such data is available and an airport listed in table 1 of the Federal Aviation Administration’s Airport Capacity Benchmark Report 2004 or any successor report.

tree.heading: Federal agency.—
tree.text: The term “Federal agency” means a department or agency of the United States Government.

tree.heading: General aviation airport construction or improvement project.—
tree.text: The term “general aviation airport construction or improvement project” means—

children.text: a project for the construction or extension of a runway, including any land acquisition, helipad, taxiway, safety area, apron, or navigational aids associated with the runway or runway extension, at a general aviation airport, a reliever airport, or a commercial service airport that is not a primary airport (as such terms are defined in section 47102); and
any other airport development project that the Secretary designates as facilitating aviation capacity building projects at a general aviation airport.

tree.heading: Joint use airport.—
tree.text: The term “joint use airport” means an airport owned by the Department of Defense, at which both military and civilian aircraft make shared use of the airfield.

tree.heading: Terminal development.—
tree.text: The term “terminal development” has the meaning given such term in section 47102.

notes.text: Section applicable only to fiscal years beginning after Sept. 30, 2003, except as otherwise specifically provided, see section 3 of Pub. L. 108–176, set out an Effective Date of 2003 Amendment note under section 106 of this title.
